name: privmask
title: Privacy Mask
description: Find personal information in text and mask it before you share it, entirely on your Mac — Japanese names, addresses and My Numbers included.
author: snaka

commands.name: mask-text
commands.title: Mask Text
commands.subtitle: Privacy Mask
commands.description: Review the personal information found in your selection or clipboard, then copy the masked text.

preferences.name: useModel
preferences.title: Detection
preferences.label: Use the on-device language model
preferences.description: Japanese personal names are found only by this layer. Requires macOS 26 with Apple Intelligence; without it, names are not detected at all.

preferences.name: dictionaryPath
preferences.title: Term List
preferences.description: A plain text file, one term per line: customer names, company names, project code names. Shared with the privmask CLI.
